lines.t: Spirit of Yahushua, come and search the inner man
Walk back through the memory rooms, I'd never let you in
Where father's words and mother's fears
Became the law inside my ears
Where playground names and glowing screens
Drew crooked lines on who I'd be
They told me I was too much
Then they told me I was not enough
So I learned to hide my heart
And wear a tougher kind of love
Every channel, every song
Taught me how to play along
To chase a face that wasn't mine
And leave my little child behind
So I stand here in your presence
With a question on my tongue
When did I stop loving myself?
When did I turn and run?
When did you stop loving yourself?
Was it in a bedroom whispered dark where shame first learned your name?
When did you lock up your heart on the shelf
Believing every lie that said you'd never be the same?
Spirit of Yahushua, shine your light where my secrets dwell
Show me where the wound began when I stopped loving myself
Spirit, take me deeper still Beneath the fear and guarded will
To every place I chose the crowd Over the gentle voice that called
To every look I saw in church that said I had to earn my worth
To every rule of men that screamed I'd fall too far to be redeemed
I breathed in messages of fear Where judgment thunder love was veiled
With threats well louder than your grace
And you seem distant from my shame
So I turned their voices on my soul
Made their harshness my own goal
Till the darker question took his throne
And whispered like it was my own
If I can't love the one you made
Maybe you don't love me
So trembling, I dare ask you now the question secretly
When did God stop loving me?
Was it when my hands were dirty, when my secrets came to light?
Did your gaze grow cold and distant when I wandered in the night?
But in the silence of my fear, a softer truth surrounds me
You have always seen my heart, and you have never turned away
Your love was holding every scar, even when I ran astray
Love says you are precious to me, closer than your breath
Desired from the very start, not an accident
I have watched you bruised and fragile, kept your tears inside my hands
Waited for the day you'd know you were never less than planned
Love says I gave up all for you, chose the cross and bore your pain
Let my own body be broken so your heart can live again
I have carried you in secret through the nights you thought were lost
Nothing you have done or suffered could outweigh that crimson cost
And the scriptures echo mercy from the garden to the tree
Love that moves toward broken sinners, love that will not cease to be
If you love me so much, why don't I love myself?
Why do I speak to your creation like it's something else?
Why do I starve the soul you feed, withhold the grace that I receive?
See, refuse the face your hands have drawn
And curse the child you've waited on
I fear you whisper to my heart
Let go of this accusing voice
Lay down every borrowed verdict
I have made another choice
You are mine and I am for you
Not ashamed to call you close
Come and rest upon my kindness Let my joy define your soul
So here I bring my mirrored hate Lay down my self-despising weight
I break agreement with the lie That you regretted giving life
Spirit of Yahushua Testify within my chest
That loving what You lovingly have made is holy rest
If He loves me with an endless flame
Then I can bless the work of His hands and call it by His name
If He sings over me with delight
Then I can look into my eyes and see a child of light
I give myself an ocean now
To love the one He's fashioned
To speak His words over my friend
Not curses born of passion
For the love that hung upon that tree
Whispers you may love you too
Because you are loved by me
Thank you.
